question: What mastery is gained by bearing this on the throat or right arm?
premises: The text may be borne on the throat.
Alternatively it may be borne on the right arm.
Bearing it leads to lordship over all perfections.
inference: Therefore, wearing this on the throat or right arm may confer mastery over all perfections.
uncertainties: The object borne (e.g. the hymn as amulet) is implied from context.
plain_english: Worn on the throat or on the right arm, one may become lord of all perfections.
